faq.question: How can I check my name in the selection list?

faq.question: Is the selection list final?

faq.question: What documents are required for document verification?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents along with self-attested copies of educational certificates, category certificate, and other relevant documents as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: What should I do if there is an error in my name or category?
faq.answer: If you find any discrepancy in your name or category details, contact the MPPSC office immediately through the official contact details provided on their website.
